title: Lucy’s Twin Asteroids Reveal Earth’s Early Building Blocks

scenes.text: NASA’s Lucy probe just photographed twin asteroids in the Trojan swarm
Both bodies share the same carbon‑rich composition, hinting they formed together 4 billion years ago
scenes.label: CARBON‑RICH COMP

scenes.text: Their surfaces are covered in cratered regolith similar to that of ancient Earth’s building blocks
scenes.label: CRATERED REGOLITH

scenes.text: Scientists estimate each is about 30 km across, making them some of the largest pristine planetesimals observed
scenes.label: ~30 KM DIAMETER

scenes.text: Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: Three stunning facts about Lucy’s newly spotted twin asteroids that could hold clues to Earth’s formation. Follow for daily science!
